why: Issue #760's lifecycle transition: stepRespawns still revives the tank but no longer says so, so the respawn event's consumers (render/particles.ts, audio/director.ts) see a dead tank come back with nothing to react to. The no-resurrection invariant accepts a revival only with a respawn event naming the tank or a round restart, so the corpus's versus and co-op respawns report it.
